--- a/documentation/codex/model-routing/scripts/bounded_or_worker_eligibility.py

@@ -42,3 +42,18 @@
 def evaluate_productive_dev_workhorse_path(path_id, task_class, estimated_or_cost):
     ...
     return result
+
+
+def evaluate_live_retest_gate(task_mode, is_local, estimated_or_cost):
+    """Fail-closed eligibility for LIVE_TEST_EXECUTION retest OR gate."""
+    result = {
+        "eligible": False,
+        "gate_visible": False,
+        "operator_prompt_lines": [],
+    }
+    if task_mode == "LIVE_TEST_EXECUTION" and is_local and estimated_or_cost <= 0.02:
+        result["eligible"] = True
+        result["gate_visible"] = True
+        result["operator_prompt_lines"] = [
+            "1 = Codex",
+            "2 = OR",
+        ]
+    return result

+class TestEvaluateLiveRetestGate(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_eligible_local_live_retest_shows_gate(self):
+        result = eligibility.evaluate_live_retest_gate(
+            task_mode="LIVE_TEST_EXECUTION", is_local=True, estimated_or_cost=0.01
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(result["gate_visible"])
+        self.assertIn("1 = Codex", result["operator_prompt_lines"])
+        self.assertIn("2 = OR", result["operator_prompt_lines"])
+
+    def test_non_local_is_fail_closed(self):
+        result = eligibility.evaluate_live_retest_gate(
+            task_mode="LIVE_TEST_EXECUTION", is_local=False, estimated_or_cost=0.01
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(result["gate_visible"])
+        self.assertFalse(result["eligible"])
+
+    def test_non_live_mode_is_fail_closed(self):
+        result = eligibility.evaluate_live_retest_gate(
+            task_mode="OTHER_MODE", is_local=True, estimated_or_cost=0.01
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(result["gate_visible"])
+        self.assertFalse(result["eligible"])
